issue.title: Bounty: end-to-end test copperhead create (brief → clean full run) + findings report
issue.body:
> BOUNTY — $50 USD
> First mergeable PR wins; paid on merge, not on submission. Claims expire after two days without visible progress.

## Summary

Run the eight-stage `copperhead create` pipeline from a non-trivial brief through a committed final stage. Fix source blockers rather than editing generated artifacts manually.

## Scope

1. Produce a clean eight-stage run that exits successfully.
2. Add deterministic end-to-end or integration coverage that detects a wedged stage, a false-green verification gate, or failure to reach the final stage.
3. Add an evidence-backed findings report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All eight stages are committed and the process exits successfully.
- [ ] Automated coverage is runnable in CI or through a documented gated command.
- [ ] Existing tests and lint checks pass.
- [ ] Source fixes are minimal, explained, and tested.
- [ ] A structured findings report is included.
